systems.system: plateforme numérique DHIS2 du ministère de l'Intérieur
systems.owner: Ministère de l'Intérieur, du Développement Communautaire et de la Sécurité Publique (direction des statistiques), with UNICEF, UNFPA and UNDP named as partners
systems.tiers: under development as presented on 12 March 2026; to collect statistical data from the communes up to central level, civil status among the domains; pilot phase announced for May 2026 in some regions before national extension

note: The platform is described as collecting the ministry's statistics, civil status among several domains, not as registering births or deaths; it fits none of the typology's classes as described, so it is left unclassified and gives no fact.
